'''Idrottsklubben Sirius''', more commonly known as '''IK Sirius''' or '''Sirius''', is a Swedish professional [[association football|football club]] located in [[Uppsala]]. The club is affiliated with [[Upplands Fotbollförbund]] and play their home games at [[Studenternas IP]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=18 |title= Kontaktuppgifter och tävlingar – Upplands Fotbollförbund – Svenskfotboll.se |access-date=13 January 2011}}</ref>

IK Sirius are currently playing in the Swedish top flight [[Allsvenskan]] for the tenth season in a row after having spent much of their history in lower divisions."}}
